productsAndServices.description: A trading model where all standard marketable and limit orders incur no fees and receive cash-back rebates, funded by fees charged to high-frequency market makers using the λ API.

productsAndServices.description: AI-powered price prediction models integrated into the exchange to provide real-time trading insights for users of the PAX λ API.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,456,701 to $11,310,416, a 1.75x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 48 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
